en: Two-sided vintage postcard. The front shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a large stone college building with arched windows and a central entrance staircase. At the top is the printed caption "EGYETEMI SZENT MÓR-KOLLEGIUM, PÉCS." indicating it is the Saint Maurus University College in Pécs. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Hungarian, a printed emblem of the institution, address lines, a Hungarian postage stamp, and postal cancellation marks.
